selection_anchor: Outcome-blind preflight froze 248 forward structured-news events, a Jul1-Jul20 fit and Jul21-Aug15 OOS window, and one fixed SIC4/theme signed Hawkes model. Event arrivals alone improve OOS Poisson log likelihood by 373.119938. The unretuned positive-intensity cohort has 25 independent group-date decisions across 12 dates and 7 groups, 297 closed unique peer legs, and 36% maximum group share.
selection_policy: Select exactly the signed-news conditional-intensity candidate only if D0-D3 pass. Do not search half-life, group taxonomy, fit cutoff, score transform, cost, holding horizon, or subgroups after outcomes are visible.
